summary.headline: Astrological Judgments and Omens
summary.text: Catalog entries 111–115 and related fragments describe astrological observations for beginnings, using an astrolabe to determine the nighttime hour, building purification, litigation and speech, lunar configurations with Saturn and other stars, and omens from thunder, lightning, earthquakes, and rainbows. Marginal entries concern requests, actions, tyranny, kingship, death prediction, and the duration of a ruler’s reign, with cross-references to Codex 7 and authorities including Hermes, Theodosius, and Leo the Philosopher.
